findings.evidence: crates/oqueue-core/src/nonce.rs derives WriterEpoch solely from CoordinatorEpoch; CoordinatorEpoch::new is caller-supplied; broker writers are per-process. Two writers using one coordinator epoch therefore create identical first nonces, while M8.2 and ADR-0050 require distinct writer epochs for all writers sealing under the same DEK. The restart test covers only epochs 7 and 8 and not concurrent writers sharing one epoch.
findings.summary: CoordinatorEpoch is not sufficient as the complete writer epoch because multiple writer processes can share one coordinator epoch and independently restart object sequences at zero.
